icd_linked.llm_icd_reason: Mapped K80.50 (calculus of bile duct without cholangitis or cholecystitis, without obstruction) and billed K80.30 (calculus of bile duct with cholangitis, unspecified, without obstruction) both code the same principal condition — a non-obstructing bile duct calculus in the K80.3-/K80.5- bile duct stone family; they differ only by the documented presence of accompanying cholangitis, an associated-condition modifier. A coder would recognize these as the same principal biliary calculus diagnosis, analogous to the J93.9 vs S27.0XXA pneumothorax example, though the cholangitis qualifier lowers confidence.
